articles.title: What to know as world leaders converge at the United Nations this week
articles.summary: United Nations head António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East.

articles.title: World leaders convene for UNGA. And, Trump says D.C. arch will be a 'military complex'
articles.summary: This week, world leaders convene for the U.N. General Assembly as war continues in Ukraine and the Gulf.

articles.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
articles.summary: Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit.

articles.title: Airlines criticise air traffic control as second glitch causes more disruption
articles.summary: Airlines are angry about the delays, with EasyJet saying the latest incident once again calls into question the resilience of the system.

articles.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats may constitute ‘crimes against humanity’, UN finds
articles.summary: A special rapporteur for the UN human rights council concluded there are reasonable grounds to believe US attacks on boats allegedly carrying drugs constituted crimes against humanity.

articles.title: Man and police officer wounded in exchange of gunfire near Ontario synagogue
articles.summary: A police officer and a man were wounded in an exchange of gunfire on Sunday near a synagogue in Ontario as members of the Jewish community marked Yom Kippur.

articles.title: Watch: Inside a camp home to Yemeni refugees as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
articles.summary: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

articles.title: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
articles.summary: Japan's meteorological agency had warned of an imminent threat to life, but the warning was downgraded in most areas.

articles.title: Man charged with causing death by dangerous driving over crash that killed 6
articles.summary: Four members of the same family and a married couple on a motorbike died in the 2024 collision.

articles.title: The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time
articles.summary: The widespread debate around data centers has become a fault line in American communities, cutting across political parties and forging unexpected alliances.

articles.title: German chancellor stands his ground after his party loses in state elections
articles.summary: German Chancellor Freidrich Merz conceded that the night spells disaster for the political center and said he would push ahead with his federal agenda.

articles.title: British Museum bans visitors from photographing Bayeux Tapestry
articles.summary: Visitors stopping to take pictures of the 68m medieval embroidery were holding up others, prompting the rule change.

articles.title: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
articles.summary: One Iowa family is switching from pigs to sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.
